# Code of conduct

This project adopts the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, and focus on
what is best for the project and its users. Harassment and personal attacks
are not tolerated in issues, pull requests or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the maintainer through
[GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/piglig/go-qr/security/advisories/new)
or by contacting [@piglig](https://github.com/piglig). Reports are handled
confidentially, and maintainers may remove contributions or block
participants who violate the code of conduct.
